info.name: Auto CRM API - E2E
info.description: End-to-end story for the Auto CRM API. Run it against an EMPTY database (./e2e/run.sh does this): the first registered user becomes the admin and the dashboard assertions expect only the records created here.

exec: pm.test("status ok", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.eql({status: "ok"}); });

item.name: 02 Auth
item.description: Register the first user (admin) and a member, then log in.

exec: pm.test("first user is admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("admin"); });
pm.test("email is stored lowercase", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get("adminEmail")); });
pm.test("second user is member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("member"); });
pm.test("detail is A user with this email already exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A user with this email already exists"));
pm.test("bearer token returned", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.token_type).to.eql("bearer"); pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("is the admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminId")); });
pm.test("is the member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.full_name).to.eql("Max Member"); });
pm.test("detail is Incorrect email or password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Incorrect email or password"));
pm.test("detail is Invalid or expired token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Invalid or expired token"));

item.name: 03 Users
item.description: Any user can list users; only admins can change them.

exec: pm.test("two users", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("finds the member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(u => u.full_name)).to.eql(["Max Member"]); });
pm.test("detail is You cannot demote or deactivate yourself", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("You cannot demote or deactivate yourself"));
pm.test("detail is Admin privileges required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Admin privileges required"));
pm.test("still a member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("member"); });
pm.test("owner defaults to current user", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.owner.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminId")); });
pm.test("is Acme", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql("Acme Inc"); });

pm.test("only sent fields changed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.website).to.eql("https://acme.com"); pm.expect(body.size).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.industry).to.eql("Software"); });
pm.test("only Acme", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.items[0].name).to.eql("Acme Inc"); });
pm.test("finds Globex", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(c => c.name)).to.eql(["Globex"]); });

item.name: 05 Contacts
item.description: Contact CRUD, search, filters, duplicate email and validation.

exec: pm.test("defaults applied", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("lead"); pm.expect(body.source).to.eql("manual"); });
pm.test("company nested", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.company).to.eql({id: pm.collectionVariables.get("acmeId"), name: "Acme Inc"}); });
pm.test("owner is the member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.owner.full_name).to.eql("Max Member"); });
pm.test("detail is A contact with this email already exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A contact with this email already exists"));
pm.test("detail is Company not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Company not found"));
pm.test("tags kept", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.tags).to.eql(["vip", "technical"]); });

item.name: PATCH null on required field is 422

exec: pm.test("finds Jane", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("janeId")); });
pm.test("only John", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(c => c.first_name)).to.eql(["John"]); });
pm.test("only Jane", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(c => c.first_name)).to.eql(["Jane"]); });

pm.test("page 2 of 2", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.size).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 06 Pipeline
item.description: The five stages seeded by the migrations.

exec: pm.test("ordered default stages", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.map(s => s.name)).to.eql(["Qualification", "Proposal", "Negotiation", "Won", "Lost"]); });

pm.collectionVariables.set("stageQualification", byName["Qualification"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageProposal", byName["Proposal"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageNegotiation", byName["Negotiation"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageWon", byName["Won"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageLost", byName["Lost"].id);

pm.test("first stage, USD, numeric value", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Qualification"); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql("USD"); pm.expect(body.value).to.eql(15000.5); });
pm.test("open deal has no closed_at", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("currency upper-cased", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql("EUR"); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Proposal"); });
pm.test("detail is Pipeline stage not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Pipeline stage not found"));

item.name: Move deal to Won sets closed_at

exec: pm.test("won and closed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.is_won).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Move deal back to Negotiation clears closed_at

exec: pm.test("open again", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Negotiation"); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.eql(null); });

pm.test("lost and closed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Acme support (lost)"); pm.expect(body.stage.is_lost).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("company nested", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.company.name).to.eql("Acme Inc"); });
pm.test("only the won deal", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(d => d.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("pilotDealId")]); });
pm.test("two Acme deals", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("finds the expansion", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(d => d.title)).to.eql(["Globex expansion"]); });

item.name: 08 Activities
item.description: Timeline entries need a contact and/or a deal.

exec: pm.test("author and time set", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.created_by.full_name).to.eql("Ada Admin"); pm.expect(body.occurred_at).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Log a meeting for a deal

exec: pm.test("deal nested", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.deal.title).to.eql("Globex expansion"); });

item.name: Activity without contact or deal is 422

exec: pm.test("detail is Contact not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Contact not found"));
pm.test("one call", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.items[0].type).to.eql("call"); });
pm.test("one meeting", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(a => a.subject)).to.eql(["Kick-off"]); });
pm.test("assignee defaults to creator", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.assignee.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminId")); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("todo"); });
pm.test("assigned to member", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.assignee.full_name).to.eql("Max Member"); });
pm.test("two overdue, oldest first", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(t => t.title)).to.eql(["Send proposal", "Prepare contract"]); });

item.name: Completed task is no longer overdue

exec: pm.test("one overdue left", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(t => t.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("contractTaskId")]); });
pm.test("member's task", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(t => t.title)).to.eql(["Schedule demo"]); });
pm.test("one done", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 10 Dashboard
item.description: Numbers match what this run created.

exec: pm.test("open pipeline = Globex expansion only", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.open_pipeline_value).to.eql(8000); });
pm.test("won this month = Acme pilot", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.won_this_month_value).to.eql(15000.5); });
pm.test("two new leads", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.new_leads_this_month).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("one overdue task", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.overdue_tasks).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("every stage listed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.pipeline_by_stage.length).to.eql(5); });

pm.test("per stage counts and totals", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); const s = Object.fromEntries(body.pipeline_by_stage.map(r => [r.stage_name, r])); pm.expect(s.Qualification.deal_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(s.Proposal.total_value).to.eql(8000); pm.expect(s.Won.total_value).to.eql(15000.5); pm.expect(s.Lost.deal_count).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("admin's open tasks", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.my_tasks.map(t => t.title)).to.eql(["Prepare contract"]); });
pm.test("member's open tasks", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.my_tasks.map(t => t.title)).to.eql(["Schedule demo"]); });

12 Webhooks
item.description: Event list for everyone; subscriptions are admin-only.

exec: pm.test("all eight events", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.lengthOf(8); pm.expect(body).to.include("deal.won"); });
pm.test("secret generated", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.secret.length).to.be.above(20); pm.expect(body.is_active).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("url changed, secret kept", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.target_url).to.eql("http://127.0.0.1:9/e2e-v2"); pm.expect(body.secret).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("webhookSecret")); });
pm.test("one subscription", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 13 Integrations
item.description: n8n lead intake with the X-API-Key header.

item.name: New lead with API key is 201

exec: pm.test("lead from web form with new company", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("lead"); pm.expect(body.source).to.eql("web_form"); pm.expect(body.company.name).to.eql("Initech"); });
pm.test("owned by the service account", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.owner.full_name).to.eql("Automation (n8n)"); });
pm.test("detail is A valid X-API-Key header is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A valid X-API-Key header is required"));

item.name: Lead with bad API key is 401

exec: pm.test("two notes", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.items.every(a => a.type === "note")).to.eql(true); });

item.name: API key acts as service account

exec: pm.test("service account", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql("automation@auto-crm.local"); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("member"); });

exec: pm.test("no deals or overdue tasks", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.open_pipeline_value).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.overdue_tasks).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.pipeline_by_stage.every(r => r.deal_count === 0)).to.eql(true); });
